item.text: The implementation is in place. The environment lacks MLX, so I’m validating the module against a small API-shaped stub and checking syntax without invoking unavailable hardware.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/mlx_solution_pycache python3 -m py_compile solution.py && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/mlx_solution_pycache python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib, sys, types, warnings
mx = types.ModuleType('mlx.core')
mx.get_active_memory = lambda: 1
mx.get_peak_memory = lambda: 2
mx.get_cache_memory = lambda: 3
mx.metal = types.SimpleNamespace(device_info=lambda: {'name': 'Test GPU'})
mlx = types.ModuleType('mlx')
mlx.core = mx
sys.modules.update({'mlx': mlx, 'mlx.core': mx})
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    report = importlib.import_module('solution').memory_report()
assert report == {'active_bytes': 1, 'peak_bytes': 2, 'cache_bytes': 3, 'device_name': 'Test GPU'}
assert not caught, caught
print('stub validation passed:', report)
PY
sed -n '1,120p' solution.py"
